report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with new-onset fatigue and frontal headaches over the past few weeks, affecting daily functioning. Has been on Biktarvy for HIV treatment for 18 months with good adherence, undetectable viral load for over a year, and improving CD4 count. No HIV-related symptoms like fevers, night sweats, or weight loss. Sleep is disturbed (6-7 hours, not enough). Headaches are frontal, on/off, lasting a few hours, with photophobia and occasional nausea. No neck stiffness or vision changes. Family history of tension headaches in mother. No other medical conditions. Patient wants earlier follow-up due to impact on daily life.
